section_summary: This section comprises State Department, Army, Commerce Department, and foreign diplomatic correspondence from April 1948 concerning travel clearances and military permits for occupied Japan and Okinawa. It covers entry procedures for commercial representatives and missionaries, exit permit waivers, and repatriation arrangements for individuals returning to Chile and Argentina. Several documents address SCAP policy requiring nationals of countries with protecting powers, such as Egypt and Pakistan, to submit entry applications through British diplomatic channels rather than American facilities.
